name: Random Equivalence Queries Complexity of Full Cube
proof: The full cube has VC dimension $n$, and the random-counterexample lower bound gives $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{req}}\geq\mathrm{VC}$. Conversely, every equivalence-query strategy is valid against random counterexamples, so $\mathrm Q_{\mathrm{req}}\leq\mathrm L$; the full cube has Littlestone dimension $n$. Thus both bounds equal $n$.
